reason: We pay about €12 per m² today with film and our own labour, and this is about €19, so I would be paying over 50% more. I am not going to push that to my director or put a new supplier through credit and insurance checks for it.
objection: If the coating marks the frame or the coated glass when it comes off, who pays? The manufacturer excludes it, and a damaged unit at handover lands on us and the main contractor. A minimum of 150 m² per job and a 50% deposit make it worse.
instead: Keep using self-adhesive film, plastic sheet and tape with our own labour at about €12 per m².
would_change_my_mind: A written guarantee that ACHV covers any damage to frames or glass from the coating or its removal, at a price close to €12 per m² all-in. Or the main contractor specifying it and paying for it.
